id: Shaskey & AKL MADZ: Codependence Tour-Valhalla, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Shaskey & AKL MADZ: Codependence Tour
long_description:
Shaskey & AKL MADZ bring their collaborative EP CODEPENDENCE to the stage for their first headline tour.

CODEPENDENCE explores how life shapes who we become: through grief, ambition, love, bad habits, friendship - the healthy and unhealthy forms of dependence that we experience.

See the EP live in Pōneke at Valhalla, with support from vitamin cos, Ifi & RNZŌ.

Tour dates:
Tāmaki Makaurau/Auckland - August 7th @ The Mothership
Pōneke/Wellington - August 16th @ Valhalla
Tūranganui-a-Kiwa/Gisborne - August 21st @ Smash Palace

id: The Weather Machine | Wellington Album Release-Vogelmorn Upstairs, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: The Weather Machine | Wellington Album Release
long_description:
Local indie rockers The Weather Machine released their 5th studio album back in May, but as the band's members have been traveling and playing music overseas to beat the winter blues, they haven't yet gathered with their Pōneke home community to celebrate - so they decided it was time to change that!

Come join the band on Sunday August 16th at the Vogelmorn Bowling Club for an early evening set, a rare rock gig where you'll be home by bedtime! Enjoy the lyrical, heartfelt, dance-inducing indie rock of The Weather Machine to help see you through to the end of this winter season.

Their new record Love & Science Fiction is live for streaming everywhere, so study up so you can sing along, and maybe even pick up your own vinyl LP record the night of the show!

Doors at 3:30, show at 4:30pm

id: Emília E Amigos-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Emília E Amigos
long_description:
The Undercurrent presents Emília e amigos!

Join me for my very first live performance!

With some of Dad's blues band members (Fish Fry Blues Club) we have Dad (Cicero Cabral), Nick Van Dijk and Paul Webster and then some other friends too (Michael Duffy and Darryn Sigley)!

We'll be bringing together a mix of jazz, blues, and old rock favourites. It's a night of timeless music, soulful vocals, and great live entertainment in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Whether you're a fan of smooth jazz, heartfelt blues, or psychedelic rock anthems, there's something for everyone.

I'd love to share this special evening with family, friends, and music lovers alike. Come along, enjoy the music, and help make my first show with a live band one to remember. I can't wait to see you there!

Sunday August 16
Doors 5pm
Start 5:30pm
$15

Tickets available online and at the door!

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆

id: Rivers of Nihil-Valhalla, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Rivers of Nihil
long_description:
Pennsylvanias progressive death metal progenitors Rivers of Nihil make their first voyage to Aotearoa New Zealand.

The quartets musicianship has been honed to a fine point thanks to an unrelenting touring schedule over the past few years, including headline tours of the U.S. and EU/UK, as well as touring with Cattle Decapitation, Carnifex, Lorna Shore, Between the Buried and Me, and touring with titans of progressive death metal Cynic, Beyond Creation, and Dååth.

Life on the road for Rivers is a treat for fans and band members alike. For the most part, its very mellow, with a lot of laughs and a lot of ball-busting. Andy (Guitar, Vocals), and I have been friends for over 15 years, and Jared (Drums) has been in the fold since 2017 says founding member/guitarist Brody Uttley. Founding bassist Adam Biggs became the bands new lead vocalist/bassist in 2023, which upped the ante and led to the release of self-titled album Rivers of Nihil (2025). Traditionally, a self-titled record can signal a return to basics and/or a fresh beginning, and in 10 powerful songs, its clear that both those factors are in play. I feel like these songs are the perfect blend of all our albums, with all the fat cut away, says Uttley.

River of Nihil have riffs, big choruses, the prog, the solos, the sax and now it will have Aotearoa New Zealand

Come along for dinner, drink specials & enjoy the show!

name: Foundations
long_description:
The Music Managers Forum Aotearoa (MMF) is proud to announce FOUNDATIONS, a refreshed evolution of its long running Back to Basics seminar series. Presented in collaboration with Ka Korokī Ka Maranga | Māori Music Industry Collective, FOUNDATIONS is a free two hour workshop for artists and self managers in the early stages of building a music career.

For this session, we will be joined by Mikee Carpenter (Manager - Georgia Lines) and AJA (Artist)

SECURE YOUR SPOT HERE: https://www.mmf.co.nz/news-pages/2026/7/16/vgjzb0thbu20b6fey3l2uvqk9ihm51

FOUNDATIONS was born out of a moment of reflection for MMF. With the loss of long time Back to Basics presenter Lorraine Barry in 2025, the team felt it was the right time to relook at the programme she had shaped for so many years. Lorraine was a dedicated advocate for emerging artists and managers, and FOUNDATIONS carries her commitment to helping the next generation navigate the industry with confidence.

The workshop covers the building blocks every artist needs from day one, including the NZ music ecosystem and funding pathways, rights and royalties, finding and growing a real fanbase, releasing music with a team around you, understanding the business side of the industry, patience in building a career, and the financial realities of a life in music. Each section is followed by open Q&A, giving attendees the chance to bring their own questions to experienced guests.

“Lorraine Barry was a mentor to me for over eight years and someone I always turned to for advice, as well as being a great friend. It’s an honour to carry on the work she was so passionate about in artist development, on behalf of the MMF.” - Mikee Carpinter
